The '''Celanon system''' was part of [[D'Astan sector/Legends|D'Astan sector]] and contained only one [[Planet/Legends|planet]]: [[Celanon/Legends|Celanon]]. Its primary [[Star/Legends|star]] was [[Nalros]]. It was the headquarters of [[Pravaat]].
